purpose: Make disposable parallel chats behave like coordinated Prometeo workers with a cheap shared nervous system, without making the human a message bus.
authority_rule: Runtime/Network coordinate work only. Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted and Served keep their existing owners.

project_selector.fresh_chat_rule: If no durable project/workstream is bound and no unfinished intent is recoverable, `Prometeo` renders Home from PROJECT_INDEX instead of guessing.
project_selector.selection_rule: A bare number after Home resolves only against the rendered menu snapshot, converts immediately to project_id, then loads project recovery pointers and binds the disposable worker instance.
project_selector.identity_rule: project_id is durable human identity; workstream_id is durable execution identity; worker_instance_id is disposable chat identity; menu number is never identity.

Prometeo: PRE_RESPONSE + RESYNC + RECOVER; never answer with a generic project description.
Load the stable entry and current runtime manifest.
If this chat is already bound to a durable project/workstream, recover and continue it.
Else if a materially unfinished Prometeo intent is recoverable from this conversation + durable state, recover and continue it.
Else load PROJECT_INDEX and render the compact numbered Home menu.
After numeric selection, resolve number -> project_id -> project recovery pointers; never persist the number as identity.
Prefer one compiled active Work Packet only after project/workstream resolution.
Reconcile only new relevant branch/network deltas, not the entire repository.
Print the violet HOME seal only after stable entry + project selector were actually loaded; print workstream seal only after stable entry + compiled packet were loaded.
If a Prometeo project/workstream is active, compare the tiny EPOCH id first.
If EPOCH is unchanged and no directed Inbox cursor is unread, continue the current frontier immediately with no Network/Delta reread.
If EPOCH changed, reload only the active compiled Work Packet and consume its filtered relevant events.

pre_response.same_epoch: May skip Network/packet reload, but may not skip a known unread directed Inbox cursor.
pre_response.focus_role: Compact durable operational map, not transcript summary.

freshness.rule: EPOCH is the first cheap shared coordination read after IDENTITY in a bootstrapped bound chat.
freshness.same_epoch: Continue immediately; do not read NETWORK or DELTA_FEED merely to demonstrate diligence. Directed Inbox freshness is independent.
freshness.new_epoch: Reload only the active compiled Work Packet; it already contains relevant convergence/dependency/delta information.

network_model.worker_rule: One status object per disposable worker/chat instance; workers never collaboratively overwrite one central mutable status file.
network_model.workstream_discovery: Discover coordination/workstreams/*/PACK.json automatically. NOW remains compatibility/router policy, not the mandatory registry of every future workstream.
network_model.locks: No global locks/heartbeats by default. Only a real overlapping write collision is blocking.

handoff_policy.principle: Publish, then Prometeo. The repository/runtime is the normal cross-chat message bus; the human is not.
source_worker: Persist local material frontier in the workstream LAST_RETURN or scoped worker status.
Publish only cross-workstream discoveries/actions to DELTA_FEED with topics and source refs.
Register a new PACK only when a genuinely new material workstream exists.
Wait for Agent Runtime publication when the destination depends on the new compiled delta before claiming handoff readiness.
handoff_policy.human_action: Open a fresh destination chat and send only `Prometeo`. Home appears if unbound; choose the project number. Legacy chat: one-time `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/p.txt`.
destination_worker: Load stable entry and project selector if unbound.
Resolve selection to durable project_id before resolving workstream.
Load stable entry and compare EPOCH after binding.
On a new EPOCH, reload only the relevant compiled Work Packet.
Consume the packet's filtered deltas/actions and continue without asking the human to paste the source prompt.
handoff_policy.fallback: A long handoff prompt may be generated only for external models/chats that cannot read the Prometeo runtime; it is an export, not canonical transport.

compiled_context_rule: Agents consume compiled Work Packets before raw owners after project/workstream resolution. Packets include only the local frontier plus relevant unseen/global changes and conditional read pointers.

conditional: Current/Catalog/Lineage when authority changes the decision
Release contracts only at release boundaries
historical sources only when recent state cannot resolve a contradiction

surface_fallback.rule: A Catalog surface without an active workstream is routable but GENERAL grants no material write scope. Scaffold a small workstream when writes actually begin.

seal.rule: HOME may print 🟣 P✓ only after stable entry + project selector load. Bound work may print 🟣 P✓ only after stable entry + compiled packet load.

efficiency_law: Maximize durable useful delta per turn: useful product change + future work eliminated + reusable learning + human friction removed - repeated reasoning - coordination overhead - verification loops.
return_rule: RETURN is an accelerator, not authority. If missing/stale, reconstruct only the small Git delta since the last known head.
privacy_rule: Public worker/network artifacts contain compact coordination metadata only. Private Capture/Patent/transcript payloads stay outside this runtime.
